BL-823 — Pause and stop intervals leave no durable record: control-pause.json is a current-state marker that resume overwrites, and a stop writes nothing at all — so effective-time arithmetic has nothing to read
What it solves: Sequencing: this ticket must land before BL-650, which now carries
`depends_on: [BL-823]`. BL-650 was moved out of `backlog/hold/` back to
`backlog/paused/` when this ticket was written — the question that held it
is answered, and the dependency now enforces the order.
Approval context: Human ruling 2026-08-06, answering the specifier's ledger-vs-scraper question on BL-650: "Prerequisite ticket: a small append-only interval ledger written at each pause/stop transition ships first, BL-650 depends_on it (my recommendation — reliable, and BL-650 is already 10 scenarios)." That settle…
BL-823 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-823" (or "reject BL-823 <reason>") to act.
